description: Drive one real firstmate session through a captain trace and measure how long each firstmate claim took to become true, with `node tools/fm-drive/drive.mjs run <trace.json>`. Use when a verify-firstmate session needs to be driven or timed from an agent, when a firstmate behavior must be proven against a live primary in a throwaway home, or when a new session-tier feature needs a trace instead of a shell script. Traces are JSON in the captain's own words, claims come from a closed catalog of home-record predicates, the primary's own words are never a claim, and the driver refuses a trace that only proves startup or steers the primary with internals before it touches Herdr.
